ai.name: Severe Anaphylaxis / Emergency Triage
ai.reply:
Emergency Notice:

If you are experiencing severe breathing difficulty, sudden swelling, or acute allergic reactions, please seek immediate emergency medical care at the nearest hospital emergency department or contact emergency medical services right away.

For non-emergency clinical dermatological consultations once you are medically stable, Dr. Mrinalini is available at La Fleur Clinic.
